sloka: न नूनम् राम जानासि महत् व्यसनम् आत्मनः ।धावन्ति नूनम् काकुत्स्थ मत् अर्थम् मृग पक्षिणः ॥३-५२-३॥
transliteration: na nūnam rāma jānāsi mahat vyasanam ātmanaḥ ।dhāvanti nūnam kākutstha mat artham mṛga pakṣiṇaḥ ॥3-52-3॥

translations.english: O Rama you are, indeed, unaware of the great disaster that has befallen you. All the animals and birds are running for my sake to tell you about me, O scion of the Kakutsthas.
